content: git difftool protocol: sets LOCAL (old file temp path), REMOTE (new file temp path), MERGED (current file path), BASE (same as MERGED). GIT_DIFF_PATH_COUNTER: 1-based index of current file. GIT_DIFF_PATH_TOTAL: total number of files. Used by alturd to show 'N of M' in title bar during difftool mode. configure via difftool.<name>.cmd in gitconfig.
